svg.title: OsonIjara: full-stack rental-listing platform
svg.desc: Flutter app on Netlify talks to a FastAPI backend on Render over REST and WebSockets; PostgreSQL on Neon and optional Cloudflare R2 storage.
svg.text: People browse, search, filter, save and publish properties,
then message each other in real time. Admins moderate
listings. Flutter on the front, FastAPI behind it, PostgreSQL
Local development runs in Docker Compose.
